title: Conormal fibre finrank decomposition with a finite function-space summand
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-fibre-finrank-comparison, the fibre differential finrank equals the cotangent-space finrank plus the finrank of the function space (Fin r → residue field).

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00TV, conormal exact sequence and separating transcendence basis

proof.text: Use the conormal exact sequence, injectivity from separable residue, localization of differentials, and the basis of residue-field differentials arising from a separating transcendence basis. Add dimensions in the resulting short exact sequence.

lean.statement:
theorem fibre_finrank_eq_cotangent_finrank_add_fin_fun
    (k : Type u) (S : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k S] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k q.ResidueField)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : Algebra.trdeg k q.ResidueField = (r : Cardinal.{v})) :
    Module.finrank q.ResidueField (q.ResidueField ⊗[S] KaehlerDifferential k S) =
      Module.finrank q.ResidueField
        (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace (Localization.AtPrime q)) +
        Module.finrank q.ResidueField (Fin r → q.ResidueField)
